stat-cards.description: StatCard row (packages/ui stat-card.tsx): rounded-lg border, p-5, toned top rail and icon chip, uppercase 12px label, 3xl value, delta with arrow (▲ ▼ —) and sign. Used by report pages; the Service Board itself renders the KpiStrip.

stat-cards-full.description: StatCard row with the occupancy warning tone and the "Floor nearly full" hint (occupancy 0.85 or more).

floor-full.description: Active Tables at 85 percent or more of the floor: value turns text-warning-600 and the hint "Floor nearly full" appears.

warning.description: Active Tables at 85 percent or more of the floor: value turns text-warning-600 and the hint "Floor nearly full" appears.

mixed-currency.description: More than one currency in scope: one figure per currency joined by " · " and the hint "Multiple currencies — not summed".

loading.description: loading is true: a centred Spinner (py-8) replaces the KpiStrip.

disabled.reason: not applicable: the KPI grid has no disabled state

error.reason: not applicable: an error replaces the whole section (see ury-admin-screen-dashboard error)

empty.reason: not applicable: this component has no distinct empty variant
